facts.text: The hotel is at 37 avenue Hoche, a few steps from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees, close to Parc Monceau.
facts.excerpt: stands a few steps from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-

facts.text: The hotel is a historic landmark reinterpreted by French architect and designer Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: a historic landmark reinterpreted by celebrated French architect and designer Philippe Starck

facts.text: Since 1928 the hotel has had close ties with artists and writers of Parisian cultural life.
facts.excerpt: has shared close ties with the artists and writers at the heart of Parisian cultural life

facts.text: The hotel holds the Palace distinction, an official French recognition for five-star hotels.
facts.excerpt: holds the Palace distinction, an official French recognition awarded to a small number of five-star hotels

facts.text: The hotel has a contemporary art gallery, a collection of more than 300 works, the Librairie des Arts bookshop and an Art Concierge.
facts.excerpt: a contemporary art gallery, a collection of more than 300 works, the Librairie des Arts and the guidance of our Art Concierge.

facts.text: The Cinema Katara is a private 99-seat auditorium that hosts Royal Film Club screenings and events.
facts.excerpt: a private 99-seat auditorium, home to the screenings of the Royal Film Club and to your events.

facts.text: Raffles Spa & Wellness was designed by Philippe Starck.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Philippe Starck, this 1,500-square metreParisian Spa

facts.text: The spa offers treatments from Dr. Barbara Sturm, 111Skin and Nooance.
facts.excerpt: treatments from renowned experts like Dr. Barbara Sturm, 111Skin, and Nooance

facts.text: Il Carpaccio earned its Michelin star again in 2026.
facts.excerpt: In 2026, Il Carpaccio once again earns its prestigious Michelin star

facts.text: Il Carpaccio's menu was created in partnership with Da Vittorio restaurant in Brusaporto.
facts.excerpt: The inspiring menu has been created in partnership with the revered Da Vittorio restaurant in Brusaporto

facts.text: Il Carpaccio opens onto a glass conservatory filled with natural light.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred Italian restaurant opening onto a charming glass conservatory flooded with natural light.

facts.text: Matsuhisa Paris is the sixth Matsuhisa restaurant and the only one in France.
facts.excerpt: Matsuhisa Paris is the sixth Matsuhisa and the only one in France.

facts.text: Le Bar Long is a Parisian brasserie designed by Philippe Starck, set around a long table and serving reinvented French classics from breakfast through dinner.
facts.excerpt: Le Bar Long is an elegant Parisian brasserie designed by Philippe Starck. Gathered around its iconic long table, it celebrates reinvented French classics from breakfast through dinner.

facts.text: Le Bar Long has live music every Thursday.
facts.excerpt: live music every Thursday

facts.text: La Cuisine serves breakfasts and a Sunday Royal brunch.
facts.excerpt: La Cuisine restaurant welcomes you for outstanding breakfasts and Sunday Royal brunches

facts.text: The hotel has a cigar lounge dedicated to Havana and Montecristo cigars.
facts.excerpt: Peaceful sanctuary dedicated to the delights of the Havana and the Montecristo.

facts.text: Dogs and cats are welcome in rooms and suites; only small dogs are admitted in the dining venues.
facts.excerpt: Yes, dogs and cats are welcome in our rooms and suites. In the dining venues, only small dogs are admitted.

facts.text: The Ray Charles Suite, Suite 714, displays snapshots of Ray Charles and has a Pleyel piano.
facts.excerpt: Few snapshots of their life are now hanging on the walls of Suite 714 dedicated to the American composer. This heaven for music lovers has a Pleyel piano.

facts.text: Suites combine 1940s and 50s design with poetic details such as books on the shelves and a message scrawled on a lampshade.
facts.excerpt: Combining the rigorous elegance of 1940s and 50s design with poetic details

facts.text: Raffles Butler service is included from the first room category.
facts.excerpt: Starting from the first category, enjoy our legendary Raffles Butler service.

facts.text: Butler service is offered from the Junior Suite category.
facts.excerpt: personalized Butler from the Junior Suite category service

facts.text: Allow around 45 minutes from Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle and Orly airports.
facts.excerpt: allow around 45 minutes from Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle and Orly airports

facts.text: The Royal Film Club holds a monthly gastronomic experience during film screenings at the Katara cinema.
facts.excerpt: Once a month, gather with your family or friends for an exclusive gastronomic experience during film screenings at Katara Cinema.

facts.text: The Saturday Morning Routine pairs breakfast at La Cuisine with a hatha yoga class at the spa.
facts.excerpt: Begin your Saturday with a delicious buffet breakfast in La Cuisine restaurant. At 10.00am, make your way to the Raffles Spa & Wellness for a hatha yoga class.

facts.text: The hotel offers family services including tailored activities and amenities for children.
facts.excerpt: Le Royal Monceau offers family-friendly services, including tailored activities and amenities for children.
